scripts.android:sync: cross-env VITE_BASE_URL=/ VITE_CAPACITOR=1 npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: cross-env VITE_BASE_URL=/ VITE_CAPACITOR=1 npm run build && npx cap run android && npm run android:debug-firebase
scripts.android:build:dev: cross-env VITE_BASE_URL=/ VITE_CAPACITOR=1 VITE_APP_ENV=develop npm run build && npx cap sync android && npm run android:debug-firebase
scripts.android:build:release: cross-env VITE_BASE_URL=/ VITE_CAPACITOR=1 VITE_APP_ENV=production npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug-firebase: adb shell setprop debug.firebase.analytics.app io.github.blazer030.sudoku || echo 'adb not in PATH; run manually'
